meta.description: Infostream is a Montenegrin software firm building systems that last: the country's tax, treasury, business and pension registers. ISO 27001, 20+ years.

hero.title: Building software that keeps business moving.
hero.body: For two decades, we've designed, built and operated software that organisations rely on every day. From enterprise platforms to cloud and AI solutions, we deliver technology that evolves with your business.

services.title: We build software businesses rely on.
services.body: Practical solutions. Modern technology. Real impact.

items.v: We develop enterprise software that simplifies operations, automates business processes and enables organizations to deliver secure, efficient and scalable digital services.

cards.v: From concept to production, every solution is designed around your unique business processes and objectives.
Incremental development with continuous collaboration, transparent communication and frequent releases.
Solutions built for performance, reliability and future growth without compromising maintainability.
Beyond delivery, we provide maintenance, upgrades and continuous support throughout the software lifecycle.

items.v: Helping organizations modernize operations, eliminate manual processes and embrace digital ways of working.

cards.v: Understanding existing systems, identifying bottlenecks and defining a clear roadmap for digital transformation.
Replacing paper-based and fragmented processes with connected digital workflows.
Reducing manual work through intelligent automation and streamlined business processes.
Continuously improving systems based on user feedback, business growth and evolving requirements.

items.v: Helping organizations choose the right technologies, define scalable architectures and make confident digital decisions.

cards.v: Evaluating existing systems and identifying the technologies best suited to your business goals.
Creating technology roadmaps that align digital initiatives with long-term business objectives.
Designing secure, scalable and future-ready solution architectures.
Applying Agile principles to ensure continuous collaboration, transparent communication and informed decision-making throughout every engagement.

items.v: Connecting applications, databases and enterprise systems into one reliable digital ecosystem.

cards.v: Integrating business applications to ensure seamless communication and efficient data exchange.
Designing and implementing secure APIs for reliable communication between internal and external systems.
Synchronizing information across multiple platforms to maintain consistency and accuracy.
Connecting legacy systems with modern technologies without disrupting existing business operations.

platform.title: Four stages. One accountable team.
platform.body: Every engagement runs through the same four stages: no handoffs to subcontractors, no surprises after sign-off.

stages.name: Discovery
stages.description: Every successful project starts with a shared understanding. Through Agile workshops and continuous collaboration, we align business objectives, technical requirements and delivery expectations from day one.
stages.agile: We adapt to change without losing sight of the goals that matter.

stages.name: Architecture
stages.description: Data models, integrations, security boundaries and failure modes are drawn out and signed off up front, not invented mid-build.

intro.v: A structured approach to designing resilient, secure and future-ready solutions.

stages.tag: Architecture is where strategy becomes structure.

cards.v: We understand your business goals and define the right architecture strategy.
We create a solution architecture that is scalable, secure and efficient.
We verify integrations, security and performance to ensure reliability.
We hand over a clear, validated blueprint ready for agile delivery.

stages.agile: We design for change, not just for delivery.

stages.name: Build
stages.description: Working software is delivered in increments, allowing feedback, adaptation and measurable progress throughout the project.

support.v: Continuous testing ensures reliability and high standards.
Stakeholder feedback drives better solutions and outcomes.
Incremental releases provide value early and reduce project risk.

stages.agile: Working software is delivered early and improved continuously through feedback and iteration.

stages.name: Operate
stages.description: Go-live is not the finish line. We monitor, support and continuously improve solutions to ensure long-term business value.

support.v: Dedicated assistance when you need it.

stages.agile: Feedback does not stop at delivery. Every release creates new opportunities for improvement.

clients.title: We do not have many clients. We have the right ones.

projects.title: Systems we've shipped.
projects.body: A few of the systems and tools we've built and run in production. Most of them power Montenegro's public institutions.

items.name: Official Gazette Legal Register
items.summary: Register of the refined, consolidated texts of Montenegro's laws and regulations for the Official Gazette, with full-text search across every published act.

items.name: DotBond
items.summary: An open-source toolchain our engineers built to generate fully-typed TypeScript clients from C#/.NET back-ends, keeping front-end and API contracts in lockstep.

items.name: Regulations Register
items.summary: Back-office register for classifying and publishing national regulations: issuer workflows, regulation metadata and EU-harmonisation chapter tracking.

items.name: Innovation Fund Platform
items.summary: The information system behind the Innovation Fund of Montenegro, managing funding programmes and applications, searchable by programme and year.

items.name: Register of NGOs & Political Parties
items.summary: Online registration and records for Montenegro's NGOs and political parties at ngo.gov.me: guided submission, seat and membership data, document issuance.

security.title: Committed to quality. Certified by standards.
security.body: International standards, certified processes and trusted technologies ensure every solution is delivered with quality, reliability and information security.

contact.title: If you run something critical, we should talk.
contact.body: We reply to enquiries within one business day.
